original_request: <<e.g. 'תסכם לי את הראיונות ותגיד מה המסקנה'>>
brief: synthesise the interviews into decisions I can actually make
constraints: distinguish what was said from what you inferred
state the sample size next to every pattern
name what the material could not tell you
desired_output: 3-5 patterns, each with sample size, a quote, and the decision it implies
success_criteria: <<e.g. 'I can act on at least one of these this week'>>
notes: Asking for top themes makes the tail vanish. If you need a total, ask for one.
